change: After unchanged PDFium BGRA rendering, use an identity 8-bit GDI palette only if every pixel has R=G=B and A=255. Other opaque views retain BGR; print and transparent views retain BGRA. No font, AA, resolution, color or cache-policy changes.
note: Two rounds, three launches per variant/input/tab count, reversed starting order. Per-launch medians for tab-switch latency; then median across six launches. Native DIBs change allocation type: Private Bytes do not account for all mapped/kernel memory. Working sets are also recorded. Sampled Private Bytes peaks can miss transient allocations. No build or other test ran during measurement. Phase polling summaries retained here; full samples/screenshots remain at rawFiles.
